facts.fact: 叙述者交代自己的航班在周五
两天前的周三她在纽约家中
facts.anchor: on Wednesday, I was at home in New York

facts.fact: 她刚写完第二部推理小说稿
facts.anchor: I had just finished my second mystery manuscript

facts.fact: 这顿午饭的同伴是丹尼·彼得斯
facts.anchor: My companion was a man named Denny Peters.

facts.fact: 当年他在缅因给一位政客当保镖，她正替这位政客写回忆录
facts.anchor: he’d been a bodyguard to a politician whose memoir I was ghostwriting

facts.fact: 她打电话给丹尼，问能否再见一面
facts.anchor: asking if I could see him again

facts.fact: 两人把见面定在十二点半的 Tea & Sympathy
facts.anchor: making a date for twelve thirty at Tea & Sympathy

facts.fact: 她十一点四十五就到了
十二点三十二分她看了手机
facts.anchor: I checked my phone: twelve thirty-two
